both_roles_power_check.rule: whole-study split -> 1 light study per role; each role needs >=37 IGK AND >=37 IGL
both_roles_power_check.verdict: SHORTFALL: only 2 fresh human complete-light studies and the IGL-poorer (Zhou_2013, 10 IGL) cannot reach 37 IGL in its role. OAS unpaired cannot power both roles for IGK/IGL (IGL-limited).

decision: ADD_PROVENANCE_AUDITED_HUMAN_LIGHT_SOURCE (OAS unpaired light insufficient; do not compensate with exhausted donors or partial reads)

light_gap_resolution.caveat: selection-role IGL is a single donor (Eccles paired, 216 IGL); meets the 37 floor but thin donor-diversity for that role. loco IGL = 3 donors.

preliminary_assessment: IGH heavy (positive_real) well-sourced: 11 fresh human complete-read studies. IGK/IGL light THIN: only 2 fresh human complete-light studies (Vander_Heiden_2017, Zhou_2013) -> likely underpowered for donor-disjoint 37/37 across two roles; pending puller yield, else add a provenance-audited human light source.
